high_level_description: The image features two bags of Popcorn Indiana snacks prominently displayed on a mustard-yellow couch. The setting appears to be a cozy living room or a similar indoor space, with a dark-colored bookshelf in the background. On the shelf, there are various items including books, a small potted plant, a decorative bowl, and a figurine that resembles an astronaut. The two bags of popcorn are labeled "Netflix Now Popping" and come in two flavors: "Cult Classic Cheddar Kettle" and "Swoonworthy Cinnamon Kettle." Both bags are marked as "Family Size!" and have images of the popcorn inside
